metadata.vintage: Confirmed from CHFA's official Dates and Deadlines page (chfainfo.com/rental-housing/housing-credit/dates-and-deadlines) on 2026-06-03. CHFA's published cycle: R1 = 9% + State Credit (Feb deadline); R2 = 4% + State Credit (Aug deadline). Pure 4% deals are rolling; R2 specifically targets 4%-with-State-Credit projects. MIHTC has its own annual deadline. 2027-2028 round dates, the 4% blackout months and Transit Zone credit terms are from the CHFA 2027-2028 QAP Third Draft (redline of the 2025-2026 QAP Second Amendment), read 2026-09-24; page numbers cited are its printed page numbers. The draft is not adopted (cover adoption dates struck), so re-verify against the final QAP.
notes: Round 1 = 9% LIHTC + State Credit (highly competitive; February application)

Round 2 = 4% LIHTC + State Credit (4% paired with State Credit; August application). Pure 4% / PAB is rolling outside this cycle, except February, August and December (2027-2028 QAP Third Draft, p. 16).
MIHTC (Middle Income Housing Tax Credit) is annual with its own LOI/app cycle (March/May)
Every CHFA round requires a Letter of Intent (LOI) 60+ days before the application — LOI deadlines are the real first gate
Prop 123 awards run through DOLA on a separate cycle — see cdola.colorado.gov/proposition-123
The QAP is a two-year plan (2027-2028). The 2027-2028 draft went to public hearings on July 14, July 16 and August 26, 2026 (CHFA QAP hearing notice)

events.name: 2026 R2 (4% + State) — Letter of Intent due

events.details: R2 applications were due August 3, 2026 by 5pm MT. R2 is the bond-driven 4% LIHTC paired with the Colorado State Credit (not 9% — that's R1). Pure 4% PAB-only deals stay on a rolling cycle outside this round.

events.name: 2026 R2 4% LIHTC + State Credit — awards announced
events.details: R2 reservations typically announced mid-December. Bridge file pattern in data/affordable-housing/chfa-awards/ will be used until live ArcGIS catches up.

events.name: 2027-2028 QAP draft — public hearings
events.details: CHFA held public hearings on the draft 2027-2028 QAP on July 14, July 16 and August 26, 2026, with written comments accepted through August 14, 2026 (CHFA QAP hearing notice). The Third Draft followed; the final plan still needs Board adoption and Governor approval.

rolling_programs.name: 4% LIHTC + PAB (Private Activity Bond)
rolling_programs.description: 4% Tax-Exempt Bond financing is reviewed on a rolling basis: preliminary applications are accepted all year except February, August and December (2027-2028 QAP Third Draft, p. 16). Limited by annual PAB allocation — see data/pab-allocations.json for current year's available cap.

rolling_programs.name: MIHTC (Middle Income Housing Tax Credit)
rolling_programs.description: State-only Middle Income tax credit serving 80-120% AMI. Annual cycle typically R1-aligned. Small allocation; competitive.

rolling_programs.name: Colorado State LIHTC
rolling_programs.description: State tax credit MUST be paired with federal 9% or 4%. Same cycles as federal. Roughly doubles equity yield on stacked deals. Transit Zone (TZ) credit (HB26-1065) may be awarded in lieu of standard state credit under a separate TZ Credit Allocation Plan, within the same fixed state-credit amounts (2027-2028 QAP Third Draft, pp. 17, 31-32).

rolling_programs.name: Proposition 123 — Affordable Housing Fund
rolling_programs.description: Colorado statutory affordable-housing fund administered by DOLA. Separate cycle from CHFA — see cdola.colorado.gov/proposition-123 for current rounds.
